Transparency about monetization

Advertising Disclosure

How NovelHaven will identify advertising, sponsored material, affiliate relationships, and the separation between ads and editorial content.

Current advertising status

NovelHaven has installed the Google AdSense publisher code for verification and site review. This does not mean the site has been approved or that ads are currently being served. NovelHaven may use advertising in the future to help pay for hosting, maintenance, development, and the time required to organize and improve the reading experience.

Ads do not control ordinary editorial guides

Normal Reading Desk articles are intended to be selected and written for reader usefulness. Advertising placement or payment should not determine the conclusions of those articles.

Sponsored content

If NovelHaven publishes paid or sponsored content, it should be clearly labeled so readers can distinguish it from ordinary editorial work.

Affiliate links

Some novel detail pages and the end of reading chapters may show an optional, clearly labeled affiliate promotion. When you choose to open an affiliate link, NovelHaven may earn a commission if you make a qualifying purchase. You can ignore these offers and continue reading normally; NovelHaven does not redirect readers to affiliate sites while scrolling. Partner sites may use their own cookies or tracking after you choose to open an offer, so review the destination website’s policies if you wish.

Ad technology and privacy

If Google AdSense or another advertising provider is enabled, the Privacy Policy will describe the relevant use of cookies, device identifiers, consent tools, and advertising partners. Where Google requires consent for personalized advertising, NovelHaven will use a Google-certified CMP rather than a homemade substitute. Current local-data controls are available under Privacy Choices.
